rows.ARS:
Red blend Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Red Intuition
rows.Origin:
Discovered by Guy Delbard / André (France, 1999).
Introduced in France by Delbard/Georges Delbard SA in 2004.
rows.Bloom: Red, dark red streaks, stripes, flecks. 31 to 39 petals. Average diameter 4.75". Medium to large, double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, cluster-flowered, in small clusters, high-centered bloom form. Continuous (perpetual) bloom throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Tall, bushy, few or no prickles/thorns. Semi-glossy foliage.

Height: up to 5¼' (up to 160cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for cut flower. Vigorous. Disease susceptibility: susceptible to blackspot . Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
